farm_pond.label: new farm ponds
farm_pond.note: 43 new farm ponds in Kalamb tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: +0.4 points (95% range −4.3 to +5.1). 4 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 6 a loss, against about 4 each expected by chance. headwater_pond.label: new headwater ponds / check dams
